verdict.rationale: Docs claim real-time balances and settlement-level transaction visibility on a native ledger (unit-docs-1, unit-docs-12, unit-docs-24, unit-docs-2), supporting the 'real-time balance reflecting holds/pending' half of the story, but there is no evidence in the pack of webhooks or event notifications for transaction state changes, and no API/OpenAPI docs were retrievable to confirm event-driven mechanics (unit-probe-2, unit-probe-3). missing for 10: webhook/event documentation for transaction state changes, explicit mention of holds/pending balance semantics, independent corroboration of real-time ledger behavior.
